Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def segs(n):
    O=G[n+' output']; H=len(O); W=len(O[0])
    used=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=O[i][j]
            if v==0 or (i,j) in used: continue
            # two directions: backward along each slope until color mismatch / edge
            L=None; chosen=None
            dirs=[(-1,-1),(-1,1)]
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                L=[(i,j)]; rr,cc=i-dr,j-dc
                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==v:
                    L.append((rr,cc)); rr-=dr; cc-=dc
                chosen=L
            L2=None
            rr,cc=i+dr,j+dc
            L2=[(i,j)]
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==v:
                L2.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
            L2=L2[::-1]
            best=max(L,L2,key=len)
            for c in best: used.add(c)
            out.append(best)
    return out

from collections import defaultdict
# For each output run (maximal same-color diagonal segment), find the nearest input dot
# lying on the same diagonal line (either slope), outside the run; record dot->run mapping.
def runs(n):
    O=G[n+' output']; H=len(O); W=len(O[0])
    seen=set(); S=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=O[i][j]
            if v==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
            runs_=None
            for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1)]:
                seq=[]; r,c=i,j
                while True:
                    seq.append((r,c)); seen.add((r,c))
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or O[rr][cc]!=v: break
                    r,c=rr,cc
                r,c=i,j
                while True:
                    r-=dr; c-=dc
                    if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) or O[r][c]!=v: break
                    seq.append((r,c))
                if len(seq)>len(runs_): runs_=seq
            S.append(runs_)
    return S

for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    D_=G[n+' input']
    dD=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(len(D_)):
        for j in range(len(D_[0])):
            v=D_[i][j]
            if v not in (0,2): dD[v].append((i,j))
    print('==',n,'in dots',dict(dD))
    for cells in runs(n):
        v=cells[0]
        slope=(1,1) if (cells[-1][1]-cells[0][1])*(cells[-1][0]-cells[0][0])>0 else (1,-1)
        s=set(cells)
        cand=[p for p in dD.get(v,[]) if any((p[0]-q[0])*slope[1]==(p[1]-q[1])*slope[0] for q in s)]
        print(f'v={v} slope={slope} {cells[0]}-{cells[-1]} candidates={cand}')

import os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[n+' input']; O=G[n+' output']
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    DD=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=I[i][j]
            if v!=0 and v!=2: DD[v].append((i,j))
    def runs(O,v=None):
        S=[]; seen=set()
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                c=O[i][j]
                if c==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
                L=[];r,c2=i+1,j+1
                while r<H and c2<W and O[r][c2]==c: L.append((r,c2));r+=1;c2+=1
                K=[];r2,c3=i-1,j-1
                while r2>=0 and c3>=0 and O[r2][c3]==c: K.insert(0,(r2,c3));r2-=1;c3-=1
                seg={'cells':K+[ (i,j)] +L,'col':c}

    print('==',n,'in dots',dict(DD))
    for s in runs(O)[:45]:

        dr=r1-r0; dc=c1-c0
        tag='H' if dc==0 else ('V' if dr==0 else ('M' if dr*dc>0 else 'A'))
        key=(r0-c0) if tag=='M' else ((r0+c0) if tag=='A' else 'v')

        on=[p for p in pts if (tag=='M' and p[0]-p[1]==key) or (tag=='A' and p[0]+p[1]==key) or (tag in 'HV' and p[0]==r0 or tag=='V' and p[1]==c0)]
        print('%s %d (%d,%d)->(%d,%d) online dots %s'%(tag,c,r0,c0,r1,c1,on))

from collections import defaultdict
def runs(O,v=None):
    H,W=len(O),len(O[0]); seen=set(); S=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=O[i][j]
            if c==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
            L=[];r,c2=i+1;j=j
            while r<H and 0<=c2<W and O[r][c2]==c: L.append((r,c2));r+=1;c2+=1
            K=[];r2,c3=i-1,j-1
            while r2>=0 and 0<=c3<W and O[r2][c3]==c: K.insert(0,(r2,c3));r2-=1;c3-=1
            full=(K+( [ (i,j)] )+L) if len(K)+len(L)>=1 else [(i,j)]
            for p in full: seen.add(p)
            S.append({'cells':full,'col':c})
    return S

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    occ=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # block corners kept; other cells will be overwritten
    def blk(r,c):
        if r<H-1 and c<W-1 and all(g[r+i][c+j]==2 for i in (0,1) for j in (0,1)): return (r,c)
        return None
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if blk(r,c)]
    for pr,pc in blocks:
        for i in (0,1):
            for j in (0,1):
                occ[pr+i][pc+j]=True
    singles={(i,j):g[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=2 and not occ[i][j]}
    # nearest block by Chebyshev
    res={}
    for (r,c),v in singles.items():
        br=min(blocks,key=lambda b: max(abs(b[0]-r),abs(b[1]-c)))
        pr,pc=br
        dr,dc=r-pr, c-pc
        side=(0,0)'TL'
        best=None;bd=99
        for name,(srr,scc) in [('TL',(0,0)),('TR',(0,1)),('BL',(1,0)),('BR',(1,1))]:

        res[(nr,nc)]=(r,c,v)  # target position -> source cell
    # check conflicts & overlaps; fill into a copy of grid with blocks preserved... but demos show new positions may coincide? handle collisions: process later singles overwrite earlier? do demo consistency
    tmp=[r[:] for r in out]
    written=set()
    order=[]

        for sr,sc in [(sr_,sc_) for sr_,sc_,_ in []]: pass

    for (nr,nc),(sr,sc),v in res.items():

        tmp[sr][sc]=0
    return tmp

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
def load():
    G={}
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl')):
        t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    big=max(cs,key=len)
    br=min(rp for rp,_ in big); bb=min(cp for _,cp in big)
    cells=[(rp-br,cp-bb,g[rp][cp]) for rp,cp in big]
    h=max(aa for aa,_,_ in cells)+1; w=max(bb_ for _,bb_,_ in cells)+1
    midr,midc=h//2,w//2
    others=[comp[0] for comp in cs if comp is not big and len(comp)==1]
    for rp,cp in others:
        ar=rp-midr; ac=cp-midc
        for a_,b_,gv in [(aa,bo,vv) for aa,bo,vv in cells]:
            tr=ar+a_; tc=ac+b_
            if 0<=tr<H and 0<=tc<W: out[tr][tc]=gv
    for rp,cp in others: out[rp][cp]=bg
    return out

for n in range(1,9):
    ok=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,ok)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
